question:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:**

What the committee failed to deliberate on adequately (1)/ were not the policy's objectives themselves, (2)/ but the political ramifications it (3)/ might have had if implemented without broader consensus. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the phrase **"were not the policy's objectives themselves" **present in part 2 of the sentence.
 
• The verb "**were**" is incorrectly used as the subject "**What the committee failed to deliberate on adequately**" is singular and requires a singular verb.
 
• The correct verb should be **"was"** instead of "were."
 
• This ensures subject-verb agreement, which is essential for grammatical correctness.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"What the committee failed to deliberate on adequately **was not the policy's objectives themselves,** but the political ramifications it might have had if implemented without broader consensus."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1:** "What the committee failed to deliberate on adequately" – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3:** "but the political ramifications it" – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4:** "might have had if implemented without broader consensus" – This part is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 2.
